subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should unconfigured OpenAI/Codex provider failures be silently suppressed from user chat, or should OpenClaw surface a sanitized generic error when such a failure reaches the channel layer?
rationale: Adding top-level `detail` parsing is a narrow bug fix, but silently discarding errors from providers the user has not configured changes provider-routing and user-notification policy.

options.title: Parser plus explicit routing policy
options.body: Recognize top-level `detail` payloads and define tested behavior for unconfigured-provider failures so raw JSON never reaches user chat while diagnostics remain available internally.

options.title: Parser-only repair
options.body: Land a narrow `detail` parser fix and track silent unconfigured-provider suppression as a separate product policy item.

options.title: Generic sanitized failures
options.body: Keep unexpected provider failures user-visible, but require every provider payload shape to become safe generic copy before channel delivery.

recommendation.title: Parser plus explicit routing policy
recommendation.body: Recognize top-level `detail` payloads and define tested behavior for unconfigured-provider failures so raw JSON never reaches user chat while diagnostics remain available internally.

likelyOwner.reason: Altay is the best available owner from the adjacent merged provider-error policy work and re-review/merge history.
